title: Smiling Boy in Jersey & Woman in Pantsuit, 1970s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot from the mid-1970s depicting a young boy in a long-sleeve number 18 athletic jersey smiling alongside a woman wearing a tailored pantsuit vest and matching flared trousers over a collared blouse. The woman's face is cropped out at the top border. An arm is draped affectionately around the boy's shoulder as they stand on a sunny driveway beside an open station wagon door, with a vintage bicycle visible parked in the background.
